values.value: Generate missing billing schedule for Order {primaryRecordId}

1. Open Order {primaryRecordId} (activated {daysSinceActivation} days ago with {itemCount} OrderItem(s)) and inspect OrderItems. 2. Confirm blng__BillingRule__c is populated on every OrderItem (a null lookup is the most common cause). 3. If null: set the BillingRule, re-trigger schedule generation (Activate the Order again, or run the bundled schedule-creation Flow). 4. If populated: inspect the Order Activation Flow / Apex Trigger that should generate blng__BillingSchedule__c — is it active, errored, or never installed? 5. Verify schedules now exist by querying blng__BillingSchedule__c WHERE blng__Order__c = {primaryRecordId}.
Billing Rule set on OrderItems; schedules now generated.
Customer on legacy billing path; not in scope for OrgPrism.
